§aSteel feeling a little thin? Upgrade time.§f

Advanced Alloy Armor gives 10 defense and 0.07 RR with a 0.75 damage modifier. Decent side-grade but not the main path.

Cobalt Armor is the real step up. It upgrades directly from Steel pieces, so keep your old helmet and boots as bases. 10 defense, 0.13 RR, 0.7 damage modifier. The damage reduction improvement is worth it.

There's also PaA Alloy Armor, which doesn't have a helmet slot (uses hazmat instead). Protection plates for chest, legs, and feet. Needs PaA processing to make.

§ePS:§f Cobalt upgrades steel, so don't dismantle your old set. Advanced Alloy is a side-grade, not a strict upgrade.
